what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4351 Iranian refugees in Sweden, 2.8% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany hosts the most Iranian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in periods from 1986 to 2025, and over Kurdistan territory in periods from 1985 to 2018.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1990 at 29948 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 33750, at the end of 1992.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1997, and the figure has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
